board_elections.appointed_governor: Xubin guddiga maamulka oo la magacaabay
board_elections.appointments_explained: Xubnaha guddiga maamulka ee la magacaabay ayaa haya dhinaca danta guud ee guddigan. Guddiga fadhiya waxay muujinayaan magacaabista hadda jirta; diiwaannada doorashada ee hoos ku qoran waxaa loo hayaa tixraac.
board_elections.appointments_records: Magacaabista xubnaha guddiga maamulka iyo diiwaannada doorashada
board_elections.board_cycle_default: Bannaani ku daa si aad u isticmaasho wareegga doorashada guddiga ee caadiga ah.
board_elections.certification_explained: Dib u eeg tirinta ka hor inta aan la xaqiijin. Xaqiijintu waxay diiwaangelisaa natiijada, waxayna fadhiisisaa wakiillada la doortay.
board_elections.cgc_intro: Xubnaha guddiga maamulka ee la magacaabay iyo wakiillada shaqaalaha ee la doortay ayaa si wadajir ah ugu adeega guddigan. Raac doorashada shaqaalaha, eeg xubnaha fadhiya, oo arag sida guddiga oo dhan uu u doorto guddoomiyaha.
board_elections.cgc_no_board: Wali lama samayn guddiga maamulka ururkan. Magacaabista xubnaha guddiga maamulka iyo doorashada shaqaalaha ayaa halkan ka soo muuqan doona marka ay diyaar noqdaan.
board_elections.chair_joint_chip: Guddoomiye ay si wadajir ah u doortay Guddiga oo dhan · Art. III §6
board_elections.chair_re_election: Marka xubnaha guddigu isbeddelaan, guddiga oo dhan ayaa mar kale dooranaya guddoomiyaha.
board_elections.chair_retry_help: Kursiga guddoomiyuhu waa bannaan yahay. Fur warqadda codeynta si dhammaan xubnaha fadhiya ay u gudbiyaan darajayn cusub.
board_elections.composition_changed_titl: Qaabdhismeedku waa isbeddelay — doorasho wadajir ah oo guddoomiye ah ayaa loo baahan yahay ka hor inta uusan guddigu wax ficil ah samayn.
board_elections.composition_invalid: Qaabdhismeedku ma saxna — doorashada shaqaalaha ayaa loo baahan yahay ka hor inta uusan guddigu wax ficil ah samayn
board_elections.default_schedule: Ururkan wuxuu isticmaalaa jadwalka doorashada ee xuduud awoodeedka.
board_elections.elections_explained: Doorashada kursiga guddiga waxaa loo isticmaalaa codeynta kala doorashada ee saamaysan. Dhammaan xubnaha guddiga ee fadhiya ayaa ka qayb qaata doorashada guddoomiyaha, kaas oo ay tahay inuu helo aqlabiyad guddiga oo dhan ah.
board_elections.every_seat_casts: — kursi kasta oo fadhiya wuxuu bixiyaa codad siman
board_elections.gold_tick_note: Calaamadda dahabiga ah = kootada Droop; gaaristaas waxay doorataa musharrax. Wareegga ugu dambeeya ee tirinta la xaqiijiyay.
board_elections.governor_seats: Kursiyada xubnaha guddiga maamulka ee la magacaabay
board_elections.intro: Raac doorashada kursiyada milkiilaha iyo shaqaalaha, eeg xubnaha fadhiya, oo arag sida guddiga oo dhan uu u doorto guddoomiyaha. Fur doorasho firfircoon si aad ugu codeyso warqadda codeynta.
board_elections.no_board: Wali looma samayn guddiga maamulka ururkan. Kursiyada shaqaaluhu waxay soo baxaan marka xoogga shaqadu gaaro cabbirka loo baahanyahay.
board_elections.no_board_banner: Ururkan wali ma laha guddiga maamulka.
board_elections.no_board_title: Guddiga maamulka oo aan weli la samayn
board_elections.no_chair_election_body: Doorashada guddoomiyaha wadajirka ah waxay furantaa marka guddigu leeyahay ugu yaraan laba xubin oo fadhiya (Art. III §6). Waxay dib u bilaabataa markasta oo isbeddel lagu sameeyo qaabka guddiga.
board_elections.no_chair_election_title: Wali ma jiraan diiwaan lagu qoray doorashada guddoomiyaha.
board_elections.no_election_scheduled: Wali lama qorsheyn doorashada guddiga maamulka — wejiyada magacaabista → kala horreysiinta → tirinta ayaa halkan ka soo muuqan doona marka uu furmo wadada doorashada.
board_elections.no_owner_election: Wali ma jiraan diiwaan lagu qoray doorashada kursiga milkiilaha.
board_elections.no_owner_election_record: Ma jiraan diiwaan lagu qoray doorashada kursiga milkiilaha. Magacaabista xubnaha guddiga maamulka waxay ka muuqan doonaan guddiga fadhiya ee hoose.
board_elections.no_seated_members: Wali lama buuxin kursiyada. Xubnuhu waxay halkan ka muuqan doonaan ka dib doorashadooda ama magacaabistooda.
board_elections.no_worker_election: Wali ma jiraan diiwaan lagu qoray doorashada kursiga shaqaalaha. Doorashadu waxay furantaa marka koritaanka xoogga shaqadu u baahdo kursi cusub.
board_elections.nominations_intro: Musharraxiinta ayaa la magacaabaa ka hor intaan codeyntu bilaaban. Doorasho kasta oo la qorsheeyay waxay hoos ku tusaysaa wejiyada magacaabista, kala horreysiinta, iyo tirinta.
board_elections.owner_election_explained: Milkiilayaasha ama xubnaha u qalma ayaa kursiyadan ku doorta codeyn kala horreysiinta ah oo saamaysan, iyadoo lagu salaynayo qaabdhismeedka ururka.
board_elections.owners_see_ballot: milkiilayaasha u qalma waxay tartanka ku arkaan warqadda codeyntooda
board_elections.public_chair_ballot: Kala horreysiintaada iyo sharraxaaddaadu waa kuwo dadweynaha u furan. Kala horreysiinta la gudbiyay lama beddeli karo. Natiijada waxaa la tiriyaa marka xubin kasta oo fadhida ay codeyso.
board_elections.rank_chair_help: Ku dar xubnaha sida aad u doorbidayso, adigoo ka bilaabaya doorashadaada koowaad. Waxaad kala horreysiin kartaa hal, dhowr, ama dhammaan xubnaha.

Xubinnimada guddiga maamulku waa inay la mid noqoto miisaankaas. Xubnaha guddiga maamulka ee la magacaabay iyo xubnaha ay shaqaaluhu doorteen waxay raacayaan jadwalka muddada ee u gaarka ah.
